subject: General Knowledge
description: Summer + winter Olympics history, Indian medallists, rings

questions.stem: The modern OLYMPIC GAMES were revived in:
questions.explanation: First modern Olympics — Athens 1896, on the initiative of Pierre de Coubertin (IOC founder, 1894). Summer Games every 4 years since (except WWI and WWII). Winter Olympics since 1924. Paralympics since 1960 (Rome).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The 5 rings on the Olympic flag represent:
questions.explanation: 5 interlocking rings — blue, yellow, black, green, red on white background — represent the five INHABITED continents (Africa, Americas, Asia, Europe, Oceania). Designed by Pierre de Coubertin in 1912. Every national flag contains at least one of these 6 colours.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

options.option_text: Faster, Higher, Stronger — Together (Latin: Citius, Altius, Fortius – Communiter)

questions.explanation: Original motto 'Citius, Altius, Fortius' ('Faster, Higher, Stronger') — proposed by Father Henri Didon in 1891, adopted by Coubertin. Updated in 2021 to add 'Communiter' ('Together').
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The FIRST INDIAN to win an INDIVIDUAL Olympic GOLD medal was:
questions.explanation: Abhinav Bindra — 10m Air Rifle gold, Beijing 2008 — India's first INDIVIDUAL Olympic gold. Hockey team had won collectively (multiple golds 1928-1980). K.D. Jadhav — first individual medallist (bronze, wrestling, 1952). Neeraj Chopra — first Indian athletics gold (javelin, Tokyo 2020, held in 2021).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Neeraj Chopra won GOLD in which event at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics?
questions.explanation: Neeraj Chopra — javelin throw (87.58 m) gold at Tokyo 2020 (held Aug 2021). India's first Olympic gold in athletics; only second individual gold after Bindra 2008. Neeraj also won silver at Paris 2024 (89.45 m — behind Pakistan's Arshad Nadeem).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: India's MOST SUCCESSFUL sport at the Olympics (by gold medals) is:
questions.explanation: Men's field hockey — 8 Olympic GOLD medals (1928, 1932, 1936, 1948, 1952, 1956, 1964, 1980). Dominated interwar and early post-war era under Dhyan Chand et al. Since 1980 there has been no hockey gold, but India won bronze at Tokyo 2020 (2021) and Paris 2024.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The HEADQUARTERS of the International Olympic Committee (IOC) is in:
questions.explanation: IOC — HQ Lausanne, Switzerland (since 1915). Founded 1894 in Paris by Pierre de Coubertin. Current (2025) president: Thomas Bach (Germany). Olympic museum is in Lausanne.
